caption: The drawing displays four representations of a pocket watch. On the top left is a detailed depiction of the watch's internal mechanism, showing silver, gold, and yellow gears and cogs, with engraved text reading "Geo P. Reed Boston Improved Chronometers Patd Feby 1868 No. 19." On the top right is the face of the closed pocket watch in a gold case, with black Roman numerals, black hands, and a smaller seconds dial at the bottom, labeled "GEO. P. REED, BOSTON Chronometer." Below these, on the left, is a simple black line drawing outlining the front view of the pocket watch with its loop, and next to it on the right is a side view outline of the same watch labeled "EXACT SIZE." The background is beige, and the objects are arranged with a balance between detailed color illustrations and basic line diagrams.
title: Watch Dial and Frame
